   536→
   537→```python
   538→# WRONG: using setDisplayFlag on cop_net itself instead of a child node

   540→
   541→# CORRECT: set display flag on the terminal COP node
   542→out_null = cop_net.node("OUT")
   543→out_null.setDisplayFlag(True)
   544→
   545→# WRONG: allPixels() on a node that hasn't been cooked yet — returns empty
   546→beauty = cop_net.createNode("file", "test")
   547→beauty.parm("filename1").set("D:/renders/beauty.1001.exr")
   548→pixels = beauty.allPixels()    # returns [] if not at the right frame context
   549→
   550→# CORRECT: pass explicit frame number
   551→pixels = beauty.allPixels(1001)
   552→
   553→# WRONG: rop_comp coppath pointing to the ROP itself (infinite loop)
   554→rop.parm("coppath").set(rop.path())
   555→
   556→# CORRECT: point coppath at the upstream null or final grade node
   557→rop.parm("coppath").set(out_null.path())
   558→
   559→# WRONG: using absolute pixel coordinates without checking image bounds
   560→xres, yres = node.xRes(), node.yRes()
   561→pixel_x, pixel_y = 2000, 1200   # may exceed actual resolution
   562→# CORRECT: clamp or validate first
   563→pixel_x = min(pixel_x, xres - 1)
   564→pixel_y = min(pixel_y, yres - 1)
   565→
   566→# WRONG: forgetting that COP Y-origin is bottom-left (not top-left like most image libs)
   567→# A pixel at the "top" of a 1080-tall image is y=1079, not y=0
   568→
   569→# WRONG: setting trange=1 but forgetting to set f1/f2 (renders at defaults)
   570→rop.parm("trange").set(1)
   571→rop.render()   # uses whatever f1/f2 are currently set — check them first
   572→
   573→# CORRECT: always explicitly set frame range before rendering
   574→rop.parm("f1").set(1001)
   575→rop.parm("f2").set(1100)
   576→rop.parm("f3").set(1)
   577→rop.render()
   578→
   579→# WRONG: rawValue() vs eval() confusion for file paths with $F4
   580→parm = file_cop.parm("filename1")
   581→evaluated = parm.eval()    # expands $F4 to current frame number — good for preview
   582→raw = parm.rawValue()      # returns literal string with $F4 — use this for repath

   584→# WRONG: creating nodes inside /img directly (not inside a cop2net)
   585→hou.node("/img").createNode("file", "beauty")   # fails — /img is a manager, not a cop2net

   587→# CORRECT: always create nodes inside a cop2net
   588→cop_net = hou.node("/img").createNode("cop2net", "comp")
   589→file_node = cop_net.createNode("file", "beauty")
